name: sequence-diagram
description: Actors as lifelines and the messages between them in order, replies dashed: who calls whom.

parameters.name: messages
parameters.description: list of (from, to, label) or (from, to, label, "reply")

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: distance from the first actor to the last

parameters.name: colors
parameters.description: one colour per actor; default BLUE
